objections.finding: The updated BA scopes child final answers to agentMessage.phase === final_answer, but it does not require codexAppServerClient to prevent child final_answer notifications from emitting top-level task_complete/turn-end. Current code treats any item/completed agentMessage final_answer as turn completion and calls emitRawTurnCompletion, which clears _turnId. Once child threadId propagation is added, child final answers can still prematurely close or misattribute the parent/root turn unless root-vs-child final_answer gating is explicit.
evidence: packages/happy-cli/src/codex/codexAppServerClient.ts:364-381 emits agent_message then calls emitRawTurnCompletion for any final_answer when pendingTurnCompletion.started
/tmp/codex-ts/v2/ItemCompletedNotification.ts:6 provides wrapper threadId/turnId that can distinguish root/current thread from child receiver thread
BA AC2b tests final-answer-before/end-before-final-answer ordering, but does not state that child final_answer must not emit top-level task_complete/turn-end
objections.recommendation: Amend BA Must Have/AC2b to require app-server gating: only root/current-thread final_answer may complete the root turn; final_answer from known receiver child threads is transported as child content/result only. Add app-server + mapper/reducer golden tests asserting no task_complete/turn-end is emitted for child final_answer, while root final_answer still completes the turn.

adversarial_questions: Could AC2b already imply child final_answer completion gating? It implies ordering/result convergence but does not forbid app-server task_complete emission, so the gap remains acceptance-test relevant.

Is the final_answer concern implementation detail rather than BA quality? It is a root-cause/contract omission in the same app-server file BA already targets, and missing tests could allow a false fix.
Do minor contract wording issues block dev? No; they are documented as non-blocking hygiene only.
Did r2 shrink or rename the user complaint? No; validation still targets Happy dev Codex-vs-Claude Bash/tool-call and subagent rendering parity.
Is this one coherent fix? Yes after the narrow gating amendment; no unrelated implementation expansion is required.
Codex challenged whether AC2b implicitly covered the lifecycle issue and concluded it did not; report incorporated that by keeping verdict fail.
